a person or device that follows movement
an area of land or a system of organs
a path or the marks left on it
entries.definitionCN: 小径；踪迹，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: a way along which people walk
a system of rails for trains
a narrow way or a marked strip of a road

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the drawing root, from the keep-track idioms, and from the picture of rails in grass.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「画线」词根、keep track 一类习语以及草丛里的铁轨画面入手。

normal.en: Track, trace, tract: one pulling root, three shapes of line.
normal.cn: track、trace、tract 共用一个「拉」的词根，是线的三种形态。

normal.en: Keep track of is to hold the line in mind; lose track of is to drop it.
normal.cn: keep track of 是把线记在心里，lose track of 是让线掉了。

normal.en: Track down means to follow the line until the thing is found.
normal.cn: track down 意为顺着线一直追到东西被找到。

normal.en: On track uses the railway image: the train is still on the rails.
normal.cn: on track 用的是铁路意象：火车还在铁轨上。

normal.en: The -er form tracker is both a hunting person and a small electronic device.
normal.cn: -er 形式 tracker 既指猎人，也指小小的电子追踪器。

abstract.en: Picture two bright rails in a field of long grass, going where no road goes.
abstract.cn: 想象长草地里两条发亮的铁轨，通向没有公路的地方。

abstract.en: Think of a strip of fresh snow covered with the prints of one small animal.
abstract.cn: 想新雪上一条印着某只小动物脚印的带状区域。

abstract.en: A track is a decision you can see from outside.
abstract.cn: 轨迹是一个从外面就能看到的决定。

examples.en: We walked along a track between the hedges.
examples.cn: 我们沿着树篱之间的小路走。

examples.en: He tracked the parcel all the way to the door.
examples.cn: 他一直追踪这个包裹直到送上门。

examples.en: Try to keep track of how much you spend each week.
examples.cn: 试着记录你每周花多少钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳克」——在雪地上戳出一串印子，那就是足迹。

root: 中古法语 trac（行迹、拖出的标记）→ 中古英语 track。与 trace、tract 共享拉丁语 trahere（拉）一系词根；更早的日耳曼来源细节仍有争议。

sensesIntro.en: From a single drawn line, the entry spreads to the path, the rails, the prints, the act of following, the written record, and the marked running course.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条画出的线出发，本词扩展到小路、铁轨、足迹、跟随的动作、书面记录以及划好线的跑道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn on the ground by something moving along it.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物沿途走过，在地上画出一条线。

branches.en: The soft path worn by feet.
branches.cn: 被脚踩出的小路。

branches.en: The prepared lines of rail and of race.
branches.cn: 修好的铁轨与跑道。

branches.en: The prints the line is made of.
branches.cn: 构成这条线的脚印。

branches.en: The act of walking the line behind someone.
branches.cn: 跟在别人后面沿线的动作。

branches.en: The note kept of a line as it is drawn.
branches.cn: 一边画线一边做的记录。

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing sharing the Latin stem tract-, and its English family uses -er, -ing, and -less.
intro.cn: 本词是法语借词，与拉丁词干 tract- 共享来源；其英语词族使用 -er、-ing、-less。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pulling verb behind the stem is the ancestor of track, trace, and tract alike.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干背后的拉丁语「拉」的动词，是 track、trace、tract 等词的共同祖先。

items.example: The stem ties track to trace and tract.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干把 track 与 trace、tract 连在一起。

items.example: A tracker follows the line.
items.exampleCN: tracker 跟随这条线。

items.example: Tracking parcels has become routine.
items.exampleCN: 追踪包裹已成了日常。

items.example: Trackless means without any path.
items.exampleCN: trackless 意为没有路径的。

items.meaning: a steel bar of the track
items.example: Railway is the full system of track.
items.exampleCN: railway 是完整的轨道系统。

items.example: A race track is marked out for running.
items.exampleCN: race track 是为赛跑划出来的跑道。

items.example: A soundtrack follows the film.
items.exampleCN: soundtrack 随影片而行。

items.example: Runway and run track share the walking image.
items.exampleCN: runway 与跑道共享「行走」意象。

definition_zh: 拖拉机；牵引车
definition_en: a heavy vehicle with big rear wheels, used on farms to pull ploughs and trailers
core_image: 一台高大的拖拉机拖着犁，在田里翻出一道深沟
scene: 春天的地还硬着，一台高大的车拖着犁从田头开过去，留下整齐的沟。The farmer drove the tractor across the field before the rain came.
sceneCN: 这里 tractor 是「拖拉机」（第 1 个义项：农田上用来牵引农具的重型车辆）；句意为农夫在雨来之前把拖拉机开过了田。

derivatives.zh: 由同一拉丁词干加 -tion 构成，义为「牵引；牵引力」
由词干加 -ive 构成，义为「牵引的」
与 tractor 同源，义为「一片土地；管道」

senses.title: The farm machine that pulls
senses.definition: a powerful farm vehicle with large wheels, used to pull ploughs and heavy loads
senses.definitionCN: 装有巨大车轮、用来拖犁和重物的农用动力车
senses.example: One tractor can plough the whole field in an afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 一台拖拉机一个下午就能把整块地犁完。
senses.why: The word is literally the puller, and on a farm the machine that pulls is this one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面意思就是「拉的车」，而在农场上负责拉的就是它。

senses.title: A vehicle for towing on the road
senses.definition: a short powerful motor vehicle used to haul a trailer or a broken-down lorry
senses.definitionCN: 用来拖挂车或拖走抛锚货车的短小动力车
senses.example: A tractor arrived to pull the lorry off the verge.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆牵引车开来把货车从路边拖走了。
senses.why: The same pulling job is done in towns and motorways, so the name follows the function off the farm.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「拉」的任务在城镇与公路上也在执行，于是这个名字跟着功能离开了农田。

senses.title: A blade worked by a motor
senses.definition: in the phrase lawn tractor, a riding mower that pulls itself over the grass
senses.definitionCN: lawn tractor 一类说法中，自行在草地上牵引前进的乘骑式割草机
senses.example: He cut the whole lawn with a small garden tractor.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一台小型园用牵引机割完了整片草坪。
senses.why: Any motor-driven tool that drags itself forward inherits the name because the pulling idea is still visible.
senses.whyCN: 任何靠马达拖着自己前进的工具都能继承这个名字，因为「拉」的意象仍然可见。

intro.en: Tractor is a coined Latin word, from trahere, to pull, with the agent ending -or, and it was applied to motor vehicles in the late nineteenth century.
intro.cn: tractor 是仿拉丁语构词法造的，由 trahere（拉）加施动后缀 -or 构成，十九世纪末被用来指机动车辆。

items.en: Trahere means to pull, draw, or drag, and its stem tract- underlies a large family in English.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，其词干 tract- 在英语中撑起了一个大家族。

items.en: The Latin agent form tractor, meaning a puller, appears in English in the seventeenth century as a term of logic and medicine.
items.cn: 拉丁语施动形式 tractor 意为「拉的东西」，十七世纪在英语中作为逻辑学与医学术语出现。

items.en: In the 1890s the word is taken up for the new steam and petrol engines designed to pull ploughs.
items.cn: 十九世纪九十年代，这个词被用来指新出现的、专为拖犁设计的蒸汽与汽油发动机。

items.en: Twentieth-century mass farming makes the tractor a standard word, and the shortened slang tractor follows.
items.cn: 二十世纪的大规模农业让拖拉机成为常用词，其简称 tractor 也随之固定。

items.en: The idea widens again to road towing vehicles and to riding mowers in the later twentieth century.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，这一概念再次扩展到公路牵引车与乘骑式割草机。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same Latin pulling stem, and the near-meaning group gathers farm and hauling machines.
note.cn: 形近组收集同用拉丁语「拉」词干的词，近义组收集农用与拖运的机械。

entries.definition: the power of pulling, or grip on the ground
a large area of land
to pull towards
an imaginary pulling ray in science fiction
a farm tool that turns the soil
a machine that cuts and gathers crops
a heavy machine that pushes earth

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Latin pulling stem, from the -or ending that marks the doer, and from the farm picture.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从拉丁语「拉」的词干、表示施动者的 -or 词尾以及农田画面入手。

normal.en: Trahere is to pull, and -or marks the one that pulls, so tractor is simply the puller.
normal.cn: trahere 是拉，-or 标记拉的那个，所以 tractor 就是「拉着的东西」。

normal.en: Tract, traction, tractor: land pulled together, grip pulled, and the machine that pulls.
normal.cn: tract、traction、tractor 分别是「拉成的土地」「拉的抓力」与「拉的车」。

normal.en: Attract, extract, contract: the same stem with a- for towards, ex- for out, con- for together.
normal.cn: attract、extract、contract 用同一词干，配 a- 表示朝向、ex- 表示向外、con- 表示一起。

normal.en: A tractor is recognised by big back wheels, because those wheels must grip while pulling.
normal.cn: 拖拉机的标志是后轮特别大，因为拖东西时轮子必须抓住地面。

normal.en: Traction is the property, tractor is the user of that property.
normal.cn: traction 是那种性质，tractor 是使用那种性质的机器。

abstract.en: Picture one small engine moving an entire field of heavy soil behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一台小引擎把一整块沉重的土地拖在身后。

abstract.en: Think of a dog pulling a sled, then make the dog iron and the sled a plough.
abstract.cn: 想一只狗拉着雪橇，再把狗换成铁、雪橇换成犁。

abstract.en: A tractor is strength that only knows one direction: forward.
abstract.cn: 拖拉机是一种只知道一个方向的力气：向前。

examples.en: The tractor was parked behind the barn.
examples.cn: 拖拉机停在谷仓后面。

examples.en: Without a tractor the farmers would need many more hands.
examples.cn: 没有拖拉机，农夫们就需要多得多的人手。

examples.en: He learned to drive a tractor at the age of twelve.
examples.cn: 他十二岁就学会了开拖拉机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拽克特」——专门拽着东西往前走的那个特家伙，就是拖拉机。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 词干 tract- + 施动后缀 -or → 拉丁形容词式 tractor（拉的东西）→ 近代英语 tractor（牵引机、拖拉机）。同族词有 traction、tract、attract、extract、contract。

sensesIntro.en: The whole entry rests on one job, pulling: the farm machine, the road tow truck, and the motor mower that drags itself forward are all names of the puller.
sensesIntro.cn: 整条词义都建立在一件事上，那就是「拉」：农田里的机器、公路上的牵引车，以及自己拖着走的割草机，都是「拉者」的称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an engine with huge rear wheels dragging a plough.
core.cn: 核心意象：后轮巨大的引擎拖着犁前行。

branches.en: The machine that pulls farm tools.
branches.cn: 拖农具的机器。

branches.en: The machine that pulls trailers on roads.
branches.cn: 在公路上拖挂车的机器。

branches.en: The small motor that drags itself over grass.
branches.cn: 拖着自己在草地上走的小马达。

branches.en: The core pulling image restated.
branches.cn: 核心「拉」的意象重述。

branches.en: The same power moved off the farm.
branches.cn: 同一种动力离开了农田。

intro.en: Tractor is built on the Latin stem tract- plus the agent suffix -or, and its family spreads across prefixes such as at-, ex-, con-, de-, and sub-.
intro.cn: tractor 由拉丁词干 tract- 加施动后缀 -or 构成，其词族散布在 at-、ex-、con-、de-、sub- 等前缀上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb and its participle are the source of every English word given below.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁动词及其分词是以下所有英语词的来源。

items.example: The stem is shared by tractor and traction.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干被 tractor 与 traction 共享。

items.example: Tractor is the thing that pulls.
items.exampleCN: tractor 是拉的那个东西。

items.example: Traction is the act of pulling.
items.exampleCN: traction 是拉的行为。

items.example: Tractive force pulls the load.
items.exampleCN: 牵引力拉动负载。

items.example: Attract means to pull towards.
items.exampleCN: attract 意为拉向。

items.example: Extract means to pull out.
items.exampleCN: extract 意为拉出。

items.example: Detract means to pull value away.
items.exampleCN: detract 意为拉走价值。

items.example: Subtract means to pull away from below the total.
items.exampleCN: subtract 意为从总数中扣减。

items.example: A tractable load can be pulled along.
items.exampleCN: tractable 的负载是可以被拉动的。

definition_zh: 贸易；交易；行业；手艺；（作动词）交易；从事贸易
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods, or a kind of work that needs skill, and to buy and sell or exchange
core_image: 集市上两只手把货物和钱交换过来
scene: 码头边的集市一早开市，盐、布和铁器在不同的摊位上被换来换去。The two ports have traded salt and timber for three hundred years.
sceneCN: 这里 trade 是「贸易」（第 1 个义项：买进卖出的商业活动）；句意为这两个港口三百年来一直进行盐与木材的贸易。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「商人；交易者」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「交易；买卖」
由 trade 加 mark 合成，义为「商标」

senses.title: The buying and selling of goods
senses.definition: the business of exchanging goods or services between people, companies, or countries
senses.definitionCN: 个人、公司或国家之间交换货物或服务的活动
senses.example: Trade between the two islands stopped during the storm season.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴季期间两座岛之间的贸易中断了。
senses.why: The word first named a track or a beaten path, and trade was the traffic that moved along those paths.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一条被踩出来的路线，而贸易正是沿着这些路线流动的往来。

senses.title: A skilled occupation
senses.definition: a kind of work, usually one needing training with the hands, such as carpentry
senses.definitionCN: 一种通常需要手上训练的工作，如木工
senses.example: His trade was that of a wheelwright.
senses.exampleCN: 他的本行是造车轮。
senses.why: Crafts were once practised along particular streets, so the way of making a living took the name of the path.
senses.whyCN: 手艺活儿曾集中在特定街道上经营，于是谋生的方式也沿用了「路」这个名称。

senses.title: A particular branch of business
senses.definition: all the businesses that deal in one kind of goods or service, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 经营同一类商品或服务的所有商家的总称
senses.example: The book trade fears the new tax on paper.
senses.exampleCN: 图书业界担心新的纸张税。
senses.why: When many people share one occupation, the occupation itself becomes a collective body with its own interests.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人从事同一行，这门职业本身就成了有自身利益的集体。

senses.title: To exchange one thing for another
senses.definition: to give something to someone and receive something else in return
senses.definitionCN: 把某物给某人，同时换回另一样东西
senses.example: The boys traded marbles for a football card.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们用弹珠换了一张足球卡。
senses.why: Any buying and selling is at bottom an exchange, so the noun turns into a simple verb of swapping.
senses.whyCN: 买卖归根到底就是交换，于是名词变成简单的「互换」动词。

senses.title: To deal in goods professionally
senses.definition: to run a business that buys and sells a stated kind of goods
senses.definitionCN: 经营买卖某类特定商品的生意
senses.example: The firm trades in coffee and cocoa.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司经营咖啡与可可。
senses.why: The verb with in marks the goods that the business lives by, as opposed to goods swapped in passing.
senses.whyCN: 动词后加 in 标记这家生意赖以生存的商品，与随手换东西不同。

senses.title: Swapping one problem for another
senses.definition: in phrases like trade places, to exchange positions or situations with someone
senses.definitionCN: 如 trade places 一类说法中，与某人交换位置或处境
senses.example: For a day the two managers traded places to see the work from below.
senses.exampleCN: 两位经理交换了一天位置，从下面看看这份工作。
senses.why: Once the verb means swap, it can swap anything, including roles that are not goods at all.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个动词表示互换，它就可以换任何东西，包括根本不是商品的角色。

intro.en: Trade comes from Middle Low German trade, a track or course, and the sense of commerce grew in English from traffic moving along such paths.
intro.cn: trade 来自中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道），「商业」这一含义是在英语中由沿这些路线往来的货运生长出来的。

items.en: Middle Low German trade means a track, a course, or a beaten way.
items.cn: 中古低地德语 trade 意为路径、走向或踩出来的道。

items.en: English borrows the word in the fourteenth century with the sense of a regular course or way of life.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，意为惯常的路线或生活方式。

items.en: From the course of travelling merchants come the senses of traffic, commerce, and finally buying and selling between nations.
items.cn: 从商人往来的路线，发展出货运、商业，最后是国与国之间的买卖。

items.en: In the sixteenth century trade also settles into the sense of a skilled craft or occupation.
items.cn: 十六世纪，trade 又固定为指一门需要技艺的行当或职业。

items.en: The verb and phrases such as trade union spread in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries with industrial growth.
items.cn: 动词用法以及 trade union 一类说法随着工业成长在十八、十九世纪流行开来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same trade stem, and the near-meaning group gathers commercial terms.
note.cn: 形近组收集建立在同一 trade 词干上的词，近义组收集商业术语。

entries.definition: a person who buys and sells
the activity of buying and selling
a registered sign of a business
to walk or step
entries.definitionCN: 踩；踏，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: large-scale trade between businesses
the work of making and selling things
a job that needs training and skill

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original sense of a path, from the compounds, and from the verb patterns with in and for.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「路径」这一原义、复合词以及动词后接 in、for 的模式入手。

normal.en: Trade began as a track, so trade is the traffic on that track.
normal.cn: trade 原是「路线」，所以贸易就是这条路线上的人流物流。

normal.en: Trade in coffee means dealing in coffee; trade with a country means doing business with it.
normal.cn: trade in coffee 是经营咖啡，trade with a country 是与某国做生意。

normal.en: Trade union, trade fair, trade mark: in front of a noun the word means belonging to business.
normal.cn: trade union、trade fair、trade mark，放在名词前就表示「属于商业的」。

normal.en: By trade means by occupation, showing the old craft sense.
normal.cn: by trade 意为「就职业而言」，显示古老的「手艺」义项。

normal.en: Trader and trading split the verb into a person and an activity.
normal.cn: trader 与 trading 把这个动词分成人和活动两面。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting over a table, one holding a sack, the other coins.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在桌上相握，一只握着袋子，一只握着硬币。

abstract.en: Think of a road that gets deeper as more carts use it, and the carts are the trade.
abstract.cn: 想一条路越被车轧越深，而那些车就是贸易。

abstract.en: Trade is trust that has been made repeatable.
abstract.cn: 贸易是被做成可重复的信任。

examples.en: The town grew rich on the wool trade.
examples.cn: 这个镇靠羊毛贸易富了起来。

examples.en: By trade he was a carpenter, but he spent his nights writing.
examples.cn: 他本行是木匠，却把夜晚都用来写作。

examples.en: The two children traded hats and laughed.
examples.cn: 两个孩子换着帽子，笑了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹得」——生意吹得再大，也是一手交钱一手交货。

root: 中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道）→ 中古英语 trade（常走的路、生活方式）→ 现代英语 trade（贸易；行业）。词族有 trader、trading、trademark。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from a path, turns it into the commerce that travels it, then into the skilled calling practised on it, then into the whole industry, and ends with the verb of swapping anything at all.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从小路出发，转成沿着它流动的商业，再成为路上经营的行当与整个业界，最后落在一换一切东西的动词上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: goods and money passing between two hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：货物与钱在两只手之间交换。

branches.en: The commerce that moves along the routes.
branches.cn: 沿着路线流动的商业。

branches.en: The skilled work of a person.
branches.cn: 一个人熟练的谋生手艺。

branches.en: The whole body of that business.
branches.cn: 整个业界的整体。

branches.en: The plain act of swapping, including roles.
branches.cn: 纯粹互换的动作，包括角色。

branches.en: The professional dealing in stated goods.
branches.cn: 以特定商品为业。

intro.en: The word is a Low German borrowing with no productive suffix, and its family is built with -er, -ing, and compounds such as mark.
intro.cn: 本词是低地德语借词，没有能产后缀，其词族由 -er、-ing 以及 mark 一类复合成分构成。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin source, so no Latin entries are listed; the nearest Latin vocabulary is commercial rather than etymological.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语中最近的词汇只是意义上的商务用语，并非同源。

items.example: Trade shifted from a path to commerce.
items.exampleCN: trade 从路径转为商业。

items.example: A trader buys and sells.
items.exampleCN: trader 买进卖出。

items.example: Trading runs all day on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 交易大厅里全天都在交易。

items.structure: English plural and third person ending
items.example: Trades is both plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: trades 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.example: A trademark marks a business.
items.exampleCN: 商标标记一家企业。

items.example: A trade union protects skilled workers.
items.exampleCN: 工会保护技术工人。

items.example: A trade fair shows new goods.
items.exampleCN: 贸易博览会展示新商品。

items.example: Free trade means open buying and selling.
items.exampleCN: 自由贸易就是开放的买卖。

definition_zh: 商标；注册商标；商标专用权；标志性特征
definition_en: a name, symbol, or design registered by a business to identify its goods and set them apart from those of others
core_image: 一只木桶上烙下的记号：买家凭这个印记认出这是谁家的货
scene: 展会上，一家老牌食品厂的展台上挂着熟悉的红白标识，客户一眼就认出了它。The red and white symbol on the booth was a trademark that customers recognized at once.
sceneCN: 这里 trademark 是「商标」（第 1 个义项：标明商品来源的名称、符号或图案）；句意：展台上那个红白标识是顾客一眼就能认出的商标。

pos.zh: 商标；注册商标；标志性特征

collocations.zh: 商标淡化；削弱商标显著性

derivatives.zh: 由 trademark 加 -ed 构成，义为「已注册为商标的；带商标标识的」
由 trademark 加 -ing 构成，义为「商标注册；商标申请行为」
由 trademark 加 -able 构成，义为「可以注册为商标的」

senses.title: A mark that identifies goods
senses.definition: a name, symbol, or design that a trader registers to identify goods and set them apart from rival products
senses.definitionCN: 经营者注册用来标明商品来源、区分同类商品的名称、符号或图案
senses.example: The company put its trademark on every box it shipped.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把商标印在每一个发出去的盒子上。
senses.why: Trade supplies the market and mark supplies the visible sign, so the compound names the sign that carries a business reputation.
senses.whyCN: trade 提供市场，mark 提供可见的记号，复合词指承载商家信誉的那个记号。

senses.title: The exclusive legal right
senses.titleCN: 商标专用权；注册商标权
senses.definition: the exclusive right that registration gives an owner to use the mark and to stop others from using it
senses.definitionCN: 注册赋予权利人的专用权，可以自己使用并阻止他人使用
senses.example: Registration gave the firm a trademark good for ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 注册使这家公司获得为期十年的商标权。
senses.why: Once a mark is registered it stops being a mere sign and becomes a piece of property that a court can enforce.
senses.whyCN: 商标一经注册就不再只是记号，而成为可以在法院主张的财产。

senses.title: A recognized brand sign
senses.definition: the mark seen as the public face of a product, the sign by which buyers know a brand
senses.definitionCN: 作为产品公众形象的标识，买家凭它认出某个品牌
senses.example: That curved bottle is the trademark of the whole industry.
senses.exampleCN: 那个弧形瓶是整个行业的招牌标识。
senses.why: A mark works only when buyers remember it, so the noun also names the recognizable identity itself.
senses.whyCN: 记号只有在买家记得住时才起作用，所以这个词也指那个可被认出的身份本身。

senses.title: A personal hallmark
senses.definition: a habit, feature, or style that makes a person or thing instantly recognizable
senses.definitionCN: 让人或物一眼可辨的习惯、特征或风格
senses.example: Slowing down to greet the doorman was his trademark.
senses.exampleCN: 放慢脚步跟门卫打招呼，是他的招牌做派。
senses.why: A legal mark and a personal habit both stamp a sign on what they touch, so the word spreads to human style.
senses.whyCN: 法律上的商标与个人习惯都是把印记盖在所及之物上，于是这个词扩展到人的风格。

senses.title: The printed TM or R symbol
senses.definition: the small symbol printed beside a name to show a trademark claim or a completed registration
senses.definitionCN: 印在名称旁边的小符号，表示商标主张或已完成注册
senses.example: The tiny letters after the name show it is an unregistered trademark.
senses.exampleCN: 名称后面那几个小字母表示它是一件未注册商标。
senses.why: Traders needed a compact sign on the label, so the noun came to name the symbol itself.
senses.whyCN: 商家需要在标签上有一个简短的标记，于是这个名词也指符号本身。

senses.title: A mark gone generic
senses.definition: a former trademark that the public now uses as the ordinary name of the product
senses.definitionCN: 原为商标、如今被公众当作产品通称使用的名称
senses.example: The word escalator began as a trademark and ended as a common noun.
senses.exampleCN: escalator 一词起初是商标，最后成了普通名词。
senses.why: When a mark succeeds too well, buyers use it as the product name, and the law then withdraws protection.
senses.whyCN: 商标成功过头，买家把它当成产品名称，法律便收回保护。

intro.en: Trademark is a transparent English compound of trade, the business of buying and selling, and mark, a visible sign stamped on goods.
intro.cn: trademark 是透明的英语复合词：trade（买卖）加 mark（打或印在货物上的可见记号）。

items.en: The reconstructed root merg- means a boundary or border mark.
items.cn: 重构词根 merg- 意为边界或界标。

items.en: Mearc means a boundary, a sign, or a landmark.
items.cn: mearc 意为边界、记号或地标。

items.en: Trade means a track or course, and later a regular course of business.
items.cn: trade 意为路径、轨道，后来指固定的营业行道。

items.en: Trade and mark meet in the market, where a mark on goods shows whose goods they are.
items.cn: trade 与 mark 在市场里相遇：货物上的记号说明货物归谁。

items.en: Trademark becomes one word as registration statutes turn marks into assets.
items.cn: 随着注册成文法把记号变成资产，trademark 合成一个词。

items.en: Trademark now covers brand identity, licensing, and dilution actions.
items.cn: trademark 如今涵盖品牌识别、许可使用与商标淡化诉讼。

note.en: Trademark sits beside trade name, service mark, and the ordinary words brand and logo.
note.cn: trademark 与 trade name、service mark 以及普通的 brand、logo 相邻。

entries.definition: the name under which a business trades, protected separately from a mark
entries.definitionCN: 商号；营业名称，与商标分开保护

entries.definition: a mark that identifies a service rather than goods
entries.definitionCN: 服务商标，标明服务而非商品来源

entries.definition: an official stamp struck on gold or silver to certify its purity
entries.definitionCN: 金银器上的官方成色印记；同样含 mark，指打在器皿上的记号

entries.definition: a name or design that identifies a product in the market
entries.definitionCN: 品牌；商品的名称与形象

entries.definition: the graphic element of a mark
the tag on goods that carries the maker name

normalIntro.en: Trademark is built from two everyday words, so it can be read as a sign of trade.
normalIntro.cn: trademark 由两个日常词构成，可以直接读作「买卖的记号」。

normal.en: Trade is the business of buying and selling.
normal.cn: trade 就是买卖的行当。

normal.en: A mark is any sign you can see.
normal.cn: mark 就是任何看得见的记号。

normal.en: Together they name the sign that tells buyers whose goods these are.
normal.cn: 合起来，它指告诉买家货是谁家的那个记号。

normal.en: Register a trademark and the sign becomes property.
normal.cn: register a trademark 之后，记号就成了财产。

normal.en: Trademark infringement is copying that sign.
normal.cn: trademark infringement 就是照抄那个记号。

abstract.en: Picture a hot iron stamping a barrel in a warehouse.
abstract.cn: 想象烧红的烙铁在仓库里给木桶烙印。

abstract.en: Picture a certificate on the wall that turns that stamp into a title deed.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上的一张证书，把那个烙印变成地契。

abstract.en: Picture buyers in a street pointing at one sign and saying that is the one.
abstract.cn: 想象街上的买家指着某个标识说，就是它家。

examples.en: The startup registered its trademark before the launch.
examples.cn: 这家初创公司在产品发布前注册了商标。

examples.en: Copying a rival trademark can lead to a lawsuit.
examples.cn: 抄袭对手的商标可能招来诉讼。

examples.en: That blue box has become the trademark of the brand.
examples.cn: 那个蓝盒子已经成了该品牌的招牌标识。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「trade 加 mark」读起来像「吹得马克」——把牌子吹得响亮，让顾客记住这个记号；这只是谐音拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 trade（买卖）加 mark（记号）：中世纪商人把记号烙在木桶与货箱上，买家凭记号认货；这个记号后来由注册制度变成财产，核心义是「买卖的记号」。

sensesIntro.en: Trademark starts as the visible sign on goods, then becomes the registered right, the recognized brand, a personal hallmark, the printed symbol, and finally a mark that has gone generic.
sensesIntro.cn: trademark 从货物上的可见记号出发，进而指注册取得的专用权、被认出的品牌、个人的招牌做派、印在名称旁的符号，最后指沦为通称的商标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mark burned onto a barrel so buyers know whose goods they are.
core.cn: 核心意象：烙在木桶上的记号，让买家知道货是谁家的。

branches.en: The visible sign on goods is the first sense.
branches.cn: 货物上的可见记号是第一义项。

branches.en: Registration turns the sign into an exclusive right.
branches.cn: 注册把记号变成专用权。

branches.en: The famous mark becomes the public face of a brand.
branches.cn: 知名标识成为品牌对外的门面。

branches.en: A personal habit borrows the stamping image.
branches.cn: 个人习惯借用了「打记号」的意象。

branches.en: The printed symbol and the generic name mark the two ends of a mark life.
branches.cn: 印在标签上的符号与沦为通称的名称，标志着一个商标生命的两个端点。

intro.en: Trademark is a transparent English compound; its parts are trade and mark, with a small family of verb and adjective forms built on it.
intro.cn: trademark 是透明的英语复合词，由 trade 与 mark 构成，并带出一小族动词与形容词形式。

latinIntro.en: Neither half is Latin: trade comes from Middle Low German and mark from Old English, while medieval Latin marca merely echoes the same Germanic sign.
latinIntro.cn: 两半都不是拉丁语：trade 来自中古低地德语，mark 来自古英语，只有中世纪拉丁语 marca 与「记号」呼应。

items.meaning: commerce, the business of buying and selling
items.example: Trade supplies the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: trade 提供复合词的前半。

items.example: Mark supplies the visible half.
items.exampleCN: mark 提供可见的那一半。

items.example: The root is written with a star to show reconstruction.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根通常加星号，表示它是重构形式。

items.example: Mearc is the Old English ancestor of mark.
items.exampleCN: mearc 是 mark 的古英语祖形。

items.example: The German word gives English trade its course sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个德语词给英语 trade 带来「路径」义。

items.example: Medieval Latin marca records the same Germanic sign.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪拉丁语 marca 记录了同一个日耳曼记号。

items.example: The compound joins the two halves into one word.
items.exampleCN: 复合词把两半合成一个词。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms trademarked.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 trademarked。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms trademarking.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 trademarking。

items.example: The suffix -able forms trademarkable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 trademarkable。

definition_zh: 传统；惯例；习俗；传承
definition_en: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has been passed down from one generation to the next
core_image: 一只手把一件老器物递给下一代的手
scene: 除夕夜老人把祖传的木勺交给孩子，让他搅第一下锅里的汤。The family keeps the tradition of cooking the same soup every winter night.
sceneCN: 这里 tradition 是「传统」（第 1 个义项：世代相传的习俗或做法）；句意为这家人保留着每个冬夜煮同样一锅汤的传统。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「传统的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: A custom handed down through generations
senses.definition: a habit or belief that has been passed from older people to younger ones over many years
senses.definitionCN: 由年长者传给年轻一代、延续多年的习惯或信念
senses.example: The tradition of singing at harvest has lasted four centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 丰收时节唱歌的传统已延续了四百年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to hand over, so a tradition is literally a thing handed from hand to hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「交出、交付」，所以传统就是一手一手传下来的东西。

senses.title: The body of such customs as a whole
senses.definition: all the customs and beliefs of a people or group considered together
senses.definitionCN: 一个民族或群体的全部习俗与信念的总和
senses.example: He knows the oral tradition of the mountain villages well.
senses.exampleCN: 他对山村的民间传统非常熟悉。
senses.why: Many handings-down pile up into a store, and that store is called the tradition of a people.
senses.whyCN: 许多次传递堆成一个库，这个库就被称为一个民族的传统。

senses.title: A way of working in an art or craft
senses.definition: an established style or method passed on within an art, science, or craft
senses.definitionCN: 在某门艺术、学问或手艺内部沿袭下来的既定风格或方法
senses.example: The painter works in the tradition of the northern landscape schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家属于北方山水流派一脉。
senses.why: Skills are handed down like objects, so a school of art becomes a tradition carried by masters and pupils.
senses.whyCN: 技艺像器物一样被递下去，于是一个艺术流派就成了由师承承担的传统。

senses.title: The act of handing something over
senses.definition: the formal act of passing something into another person's keeping
senses.definitionCN: 把某物正式交到他人手里的行为
senses.example: The tradition of the keys to the new mayor takes place at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 把钥匙交给新市长的仪式在正午举行。
senses.why: This is the oldest legal sense, still visible in the English verb hand over.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的法律含义，在英语 hand over 这一说法里仍能看见。

senses.title: A long-held custom in an institution
senses.definition: an established practice in a school, office, or team that everyone follows
senses.definitionCN: 学校、机关或团队里人人遵循的既定做法
senses.example: It is a tradition here that the newest member makes the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这里有个惯例：最新来的成员负责泡茶。
senses.why: Small groups create their own handings-down, and the word serves for these everyday customs too.
senses.whyCN: 小群体也会形成自己的传递，这个词同样用于这些日常惯例。

intro.en: Tradition comes from Latin traditio, a handing over, from tradere, to hand across, made of trans-, across, and dare, to give.
intro.cn: tradition 来自拉丁语 traditio（交付），源自 tradere（交过去），由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Tradere is built from trans-, across, and dare, to give, and means to hand over or deliver.
items.cn: tradere 由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）合成，意为交出、交付。

items.en: Traditio names the act of delivery and, in law, the transfer of property into another's hands.
items.cn: traditio 指交付行为，在法律上指把财产转移到他方手中。

items.en: Old French tradition keeps the sense of handing down teaching and custom.
items.cn: 古法语 tradition 保留了传授教义与习俗的含义。

items.en: English uses tradition first in religious writing for teaching received from the fathers of the church.
items.cn: 英语最先在宗教文献中使用 tradition，指从教父那里接受的教导。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word widens to any custom or practice inherited from the past.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，这个词扩展到任何从过去继承下来的习俗或做法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same giving stem, while the near-meaning group gathers customs and inherited practice.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一「给」词根的词，近义组收集习俗与沿袭的做法。

entries.definition: following old customs
in the old customary way
one who hands over his own side
to hand someone over to an enemy
a usual way of behaving in a group
the things and ways inherited from the past
an accepted way of doing things

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the giving root, from the family of -al, -ly, and -ism, and from the picture of a handover.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「给」的词根、由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族以及「递交」的画面入手。

normal.en: Trans- plus dare: give across. A tradition is what gets given across the years.
normal.cn: trans- 加 dare，就是「给过去」。传统就是被给过岁月的那些东西。

normal.en: The same root gives traitor and betray, because to hand someone over is also to betray.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 traitor 与 betray，因为把人交出去也就是出卖。

normal.en: Traditional adds -al, traditionally adds -ly, traditionalism adds -ism.
normal.cn: traditional 加 -al，traditionally 加 -ly，traditionalism 加 -ism。

normal.en: Break with tradition and keep the tradition are opposites in one phrase family.
normal.cn: break with tradition 与 keep the tradition 是同一搭配族里的对立面。

normal.en: The word ends in -tion, so it names the thing and the act of handing down at once.
normal.cn: 本词以 -tion 结尾，同时指被传下来的东西与传递这一行为。

abstract.en: Picture an old wooden spoon passed from a grandmother's hand to a grandchild's.
abstract.cn: 想象一把旧木勺从祖母的手递到孙辈的手里。

abstract.en: Think of a path worn by many feet over centuries, still visible under fresh grass.
abstract.cn: 想一条被几百年脚步踩出的路，如今仍在新草下隐约可见。

abstract.en: A tradition is a choice that has already been made many times before you make it.
abstract.cn: 传统是一个在你做出之前就已经被做过许多次的选择。

examples.en: It is a tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.cn: 除夕吃饺子是一项传统。

examples.en: The village has kept its fishing traditions for many centuries.
examples.cn: 这个村子把捕鱼传统保留了许多个世纪。

examples.en: By tradition the eldest son lights the first lamp.
examples.cn: 按照传统，由长子点亮第一盏灯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递什」——一代人穿过时间把手里的东西递交给下一代。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ dare（给）→ tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传交）→ 古法语 tradition → 英语 tradition。同源词有 traitor、betray、tradition（教义传承义）。

sensesIntro.en: The root means a handover, so the entry begins with the custom handed down, gathers such handovers into a people's whole store, narrows to the school of an art, returns to the bare legal handover, and ends with the small customs of an institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 词根意为「递交」，因此本词先指被递下来的习俗，再把递交聚成一个民族的全部家底，收窄为艺术流派，回到纯粹的法律交付，最后落在团体内部的小惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing passed from an older hand into a younger one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西从年长的手递进年轻的手。

branches.en: The single custom handed down.
branches.cn: 被递下来的一项习俗。

branches.en: All such customs together.
branches.cn: 全部这类习俗的总体。

branches.en: A tradition inside an art or craft.
branches.cn: 艺术或手艺内部的传承体系。

branches.en: The bare act of delivery in law.
branches.cn: 法律上纯粹的交付行为。

branches.en: The small habit of a group.
branches.cn: 小团体的日常惯例。

intro.en: The word rests on the Latin verb dare, to give, with the prefix trans- and the noun ending -tio; English adds -al, -ly, and -ism.
intro.cn: 本词建立在拉丁语动词 dare（给）之上，配前缀 trans- 与名词词尾 -tio；英语再加 -al、-ly、-ism。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries below show the giving verb and the handing-over noun behind this word.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出本词背后的「给」动词与「交付」名词。

items.example: Dare is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: dare 是这个词族的核心动词。

items.example: Trans- turns giving into giving across.
items.exampleCN: trans- 把给变成「给过去」。

items.example: Tradition is the handing down and what is handed down.
items.exampleCN: tradition 既是传递行为也是传递之物。

items.example: Traditional means relating to tradition.
items.exampleCN: traditional 意为与传统相关的。

items.example: Traditionally adds the adverb ending.
items.exampleCN: traditionally 加上副词词尾。

items.example: Traditionalism values the old ways.
items.exampleCN: traditionalism 重视旧有方式。

items.example: A traditionalist follows old customs.
items.exampleCN: traditionalist 遵循旧俗。

items.example: Traitor keeps the older sense of handing over.
items.exampleCN: traitor 保留了「交出」的旧义。

definition_zh: 传统的；惯例的；因袭的
definition_en: following or belonging to the customs and beliefs that have been handed down over a long time
core_image: 一件按老样子做成的家具，榫卯没上一颗钉子
scene: 木匠铺里那张老式方桌不用一颗钉子，全靠榫头咬合，看的人都说是老样子。Her wedding dress was traditional, with hand embroidery at the collar.
sceneCN: 这里 traditional 是「传统的」（第 1 个义项：遵循长期沿袭下来的样式或做法）；句意为她的婚纱是传统样式，领口有手工刺绣。

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -al 得到名词，义为「传统」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: Following old customs
senses.definition: made or done according to the customs and styles of the past
senses.definitionCN: 按照过去的习俗与样式制作或执行
senses.example: They served a traditional dish of rice and salted fish.
senses.exampleCN: 他们上了一道米饭配咸鱼的传统菜。
senses.why: The adjective simply says that a thing belongs to what has been handed down.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是说某物属于那些被传下来的东西。

senses.title: Belonging to an older system of ideas
senses.definition: belonging to an older way of thinking and often opposed to newer ideas
senses.definitionCN: 属于较旧的思维方式，常与较新的观念相对
senses.example: He holds fairly traditional views on family life.
senses.exampleCN: 他对家庭生活的看法相当传统。
senses.why: What is handed down can be a belief rather than an object, so the adjective also describes attitudes.
senses.whyCN: 被传下来的可以是信念而非器物，因此这个形容词也能描写态度。

senses.title: Established by long practice in a field
senses.definition: describing the standard method used for a long time in an art, craft, or industry
senses.definitionCN: 指某项艺术、工艺或行业中长期使用的标准方法
senses.example: The traditional method of dyeing uses indigo leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 传统的染色方法使用蓝草叶。
senses.why: Method is passed from master to pupil, so the usual technique of a trade counts as traditional.
senses.whyCN: 方法是师徒相传的，所以一门行当的常用技法就被视为传统的。

senses.title: Of the old style rather than the new
senses.definition: built or designed in a way that imitates older forms, often as a positive value
senses.definitionCN: 以模仿较古老形式的方式建造或设计的，常含褒义
senses.example: The new library has a traditional stone front but a glass hall.
senses.exampleCN: 新图书馆有着传统的石砌立面，里面却是玻璃大厅。
senses.why: Architecture borrows the label to say it keeps the old shape while using new materials.
senses.whyCN: 建筑借用这个标签，表示它保留旧形态却使用新材料。

senses.title: Using the older classified method
senses.definition: in grammar and teaching, describing methods that keep the older ordered forms
senses.definitionCN: 在语法与教学中，指保留旧有程式的方法
senses.example: Traditional grammar lists the eight parts of speech.
senses.exampleCN: 传统语法列出八种词类。
senses.why: Every discipline keeps a set of inherited terms, and those are labelled traditional to mark them off from new ones.
senses.whyCN: 每门学问都保存着一套继承下来的术语，用 traditional 来标记它们以区别于新术语。

intro.en: Traditional is a later English formation from tradition, which came from Latin traditio, a delivering over, with the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: traditional 是英语后来由 tradition 加形容词后缀 -al 构成；tradition 源自拉丁语 traditio（交付）。

items.en: Traditio means a handing over or delivery, and traditionalis appears in late Latin for what is handed down.
items.cn: traditio 意为交付、递交，晚期拉丁语中已有 traditionalis 表示「被传下来的」。

items.en: French tradition carries the noun into learned use, and its adjective traditionel follows.
items.cn: 法语 tradition 把这个名词带进书面语，其形容词 traditionel 也随之出现。

items.en: English forms traditional in the sixteenth century, at first for teaching received from authority.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪构成 traditional，起初指从权威那里领受的教导。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word is applied to styles of art and building that imitate older forms.
items.cn: 十九世纪，这个词被用来指模仿较早形式的艺术与建筑风格。

items.en: The comparative more traditional and the phrase traditional values become common in ordinary speech in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 比较级 more traditional 与传统一说传统的价值在二十世纪成为日常说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the word family built with -al, -ly, and -ism, while the near-meaning group gathers words for old and inherited ways.
note.cn: 形近组收集由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族，近义组收集表示古老与承袭的词。

entries.definition: a custom handed down
in the customary way
valuing old ways of doing things
relating to a change from one state to another
entries.definitionCN: 过渡的，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: following what is generally accepted
of an older style, sometimes disapproving
usual according to custom

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the -al suffix, from the compound habits of the word, and from the picture of nail-free joinery.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从 -al 后缀、本词的复合搭配以及不用钉子的榫接画面入手。

normal.en: Tradition plus -al: the suffix turns the custom into a description.
normal.cn: tradition 加 -al，后缀把习俗变成一种描述。

normal.en: Traditional method, traditional culture, traditional values: three very common partners.
normal.cn: traditional method、traditional culture、traditional values，三个最常见的搭档。

normal.en: Words ending in -al take more and most, not -er and -est.
normal.cn: 以 -al 结尾的词用 more 与 most，不用 -er 与 -est。

normal.en: Traditional is neutral; old-fashioned often carries a hint of blame.
normal.cn: traditional 是中性的，old-fashioned 常含一点批评。

normal.en: A traditional building copies the shape of older ones even when the materials are new.
normal.cn: 传统建筑即便用新材料，也照抄了更早建筑的外形。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden table held together without a single nail, only by cut joints.
abstract.cn: 想象一张木桌一颗钉子也没用，全靠凿出的榫卯扣住。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe written in a grandmother's hand and never changed.
abstract.cn: 想一份祖母手写、从未改过的菜谱。

abstract.en: Traditional is what time has tested and left standing.
abstract.cn: 传统就是被时间检验过、仍然立着的东西。

examples.en: They cooked the meal in the traditional way, over a wood fire.
examples.cn: 他们用传统方式做饭，在柴火上煮。

examples.en: Traditional medicine is still widely used in the countryside.
examples.cn: 传统医学在乡间仍然广泛使用。

examples.en: Her family is more traditional than mine.
examples.cn: 她的家庭比我家更传统。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递神呢」——一代代穿递下来的神气东西，就叫传统式的。

root: 拉丁语 tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传承）→ 英语 tradition + 形容词后缀 -al → traditional。词族另有 -ly、-ism、-ist 等形式。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective begins with objects made by old custom, moves to beliefs, then to the established method of a craft, then to imitated older styles, and finally to inherited terms in a discipline.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词先指按旧俗做成的事物，转到信念，再到一门手艺的既定方法，再到被模仿的旧风格，最后指一门学问里被继承的术语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing made the old way, without any new part.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件按老办法做成、没有任何新部件的东西。

branches.en: Things made by old custom.
branches.cn: 按旧俗做成的事物。

branches.en: Beliefs carried from the older system.
branches.cn: 来自较旧体系的信念。

branches.en: The standard technique of a trade.
branches.cn: 一门行当的标准技法。

branches.en: Older shapes imitated in new building.
branches.cn: 新建筑中模仿的旧形态。

branches.en: The inherited terms of a discipline.
branches.cn: 一门学问继承下来的术语。

intro.en: Traditional is tradition plus the Latin adjective suffix -al, and its family uses -ly, -ism, and -ist.
intro.cn: traditional 是 tradition 加拉丁形容词后缀 -al，其词族使用 -ly、-ism、-ist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin giving verb behind the noun is shown below with the handover noun and the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 下面列出名词背后的拉丁语「给」动词，以及表示交付的名词与形容词。

items.example: Dare sits at the root of the noun.
items.exampleCN: dare 位于这个名词的词根处。

items.example: The prefix makes giving into handing over.

definition_zh: 悲剧；惨案；不幸事件；悲剧体裁
definition_en: a very sad event or situation, or a serious play that ends unhappily
core_image: 空荡的舞台上，一只倒下的面具
scene: 最后一幕落下时，主角已经倒在台上，观众席里没有人马上起身鼓掌。The play is a tragedy; everyone on stage loses something by the end.
sceneCN: 这里 tragedy 是「悲剧」（第 1 个义项：结局悲惨的严肃戏剧）；句意说这是一出悲剧，到结尾台上每个人都失去了些什么。

derivatives.zh: 由同一词干加 -ic 构成，义为「悲剧的；悲惨的」

senses.title: A serious play with an unhappy end
senses.definition: a serious drama in which the main character suffers greatly and usually dies
senses.definitionCN: 主角遭受重大苦难、通常以死亡收场的严肃戏剧
senses.example: We studied three tragedies by Shakespeare this term.
senses.exampleCN: 这学期我们学了三部莎士比亚的悲剧。
senses.why: The Greek word names a specific kind of drama, and the literary sense remains the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 希腊文原名就指某一类戏剧，文学义至今仍是这个词的核心。

senses.title: A very sad event
senses.definition: a terrible event that causes great suffering, such as an accident or a disaster
senses.definitionCN: 造成巨大痛苦的可怕事件，如事故或灾难
senses.example: The fire was a tragedy that the village has never forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 那场大火是这个村子从未忘掉的惨剧。
senses.why: Real disasters were said to have the shape of a stage tragedy, and the word passed into ordinary life.
senses.whyCN: 现实的灾难被说成具有舞台悲剧的形态，于是这个词进入了日常生活。

senses.title: Great suffering that seems fated
senses.definition: a pattern of suffering that appears inevitable and beyond human control
senses.definitionCN: 看起来无可避免、超出人力控制的一连串苦难
senses.example: The family's story has the slow tragedy of a Greek play.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人的经历有希腊剧那样缓慢的悲剧性。
senses.why: In Greek drama the hero's fall is fated, and that sense of inevitability colours the everyday word.
senses.whyCN: 希腊剧中英雄的坠落是命定的，这种必然感为日常用法染了色。

senses.title: The genre of such plays
senses.definition: the whole class of dramatic works of this kind, often opposed to comedy
senses.definitionCN: 这一类戏剧作品的总称，常与喜剧相对
senses.example: The two masks of the theatre stand for tragedy and comedy.
senses.exampleCN: 剧场的两副面具代表悲剧与喜剧。
senses.why: As a genre, tragedy is a form rather than an event, and criticism keeps the word in this technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 作为体裁，tragedy 是一种形式而非事件，文艺批评一直保持着这个术语义。

senses.title: A regrettable situation
senses.definition: used in the pattern it is a tragedy that to say something is deeply regrettable
senses.definitionCN: 用于 it is a tragedy that 句型，表示某事令人深感痛心
senses.example: It is a tragedy that so many old trees were cut down.
senses.exampleCN: 这么多老树被砍掉，实在令人痛心。
senses.why: The word's weight becomes a way of expressing strong regret, even over things that cost no lives.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的分量成了一种表达强烈遗憾的方式，即使并不涉及生命。

intro.en: Tragedy comes from Greek tragoidia, literally goat-song, from tragos, goat, and aeidein, to sing, probably from the goat given as a prize.
intro.cn: tragedy 来自希腊语 tragoidia，字面是「山羊之歌」，由 tragos（山羊）与 aeidein（歌唱）构成，可能源自律唱比赛的羊奖品。

items.en: Tragoidia is the name of a choral performance in Athens, built from tragos, goat, and ode, song.
items.cn: tragoidia 是雅典一种合唱歌舞的名称，由 tragos（山羊）与 ode（歌）构成。

items.en: The goat may have been the prize for the best chorus, or the animal sacrificed before the performance.
items.cn: 山羊可能是最佳合唱队的奖品，也可能是演出前献祭的牺牲。

items.en: In Athens tragedy becomes the great serious drama of Aeschylus, Sophocles, and Euripides.
items.cn: 在雅典，tragedy 成为埃斯库罗斯、索福克勒斯与欧里庇得斯的伟大严肃戏剧。

items.en: Latin tragoedia borrows the Greek word and passes the dramatic sense to European schools.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tragoedia 借走这个希腊词，并把戏剧含义传给欧洲的学校。

items.en: Middle English tragedy first means a story, often in verse, with a sad ending.
items.cn: 中古英语 tragedy 最初指一个以悲收场的故事，常为韵文。

items.en: From the eighteenth century the word also describes real disasters, and the figurative use widens from there.
items.cn: 十八世纪起，这个词也用来描述真实的灾难，比喻用法自此扩展。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Greek stage family, while the near-meaning group gathers words for disaster and suffering.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一希腊舞台词族的词，近义组收集表示灾难与苦难的词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the goat-song origin, from the theatre masks, and from the pattern it is a tragedy that.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「山羊之歌」的来源、剧场面具以及 it is a tragedy that 句型入手。

normal.en: Tragos plus ode: goat song. The strange name survives inside the serious play.
normal.cn: tragos 加 ode，就是山羊之歌。这个古怪的名字藏在严肃戏剧里面。

normal.en: Two masks: the smiling one is comedy, the weeping one is tragedy.
normal.cn: 两副面具：笑的那副是喜剧，哭的那副是悲剧。

normal.en: Tragedy as a genre ends badly; tragedy as an event hurts now.
normal.cn: 作为体裁的悲剧结局不好；作为事件的悲剧当下就伤人。

normal.en: It is a tragedy that plus a fact is a formal way of saying something is deeply sad.
normal.cn: it is a tragedy that 加一个事实，是表达「令人深感痛心」的正规说法。

normal.en: The -dy ending is not a suffix, so remove nothing: the whole word is the root.
normal.cn: 词尾 -dy 不是后缀，不要拆掉，整个词就是词根。

abstract.en: Picture a single actor alone on a lit stage after everyone else has left.
abstract.cn: 想象灯还亮着，别人都走了，台上只剩一个演员。

abstract.en: Think of a goat standing quietly at the back of a Greek chorus, waiting to be a prize.
abstract.cn: 想一只山羊安静地站在希腊合唱队后面，等着当奖品。

abstract.en: A tragedy is a loss that could not have been stopped in time.
abstract.cn: 悲剧是一场来不及被拦住的失去。

examples.en: The accident on the bridge was a terrible tragedy.
examples.cn: 桥上的那场事故是可怕的惨剧。

examples.en: He wrote three tragedies before he was thirty.
examples.cn: 他三十岁前写了三部悲剧。

examples.en: It is a tragedy that she left the course so early.
examples.cn: 她这么早就离开课程，实在可惜。

root: 希腊语 tragoidia（山羊之歌）= tragos（山羊）+ ode（歌）→ 拉丁语 tragoedia → 中古英语 tragedy。同族词有 tragic、tragically、tragedian。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts with the stage play, moves to real disasters that move like a play, then to the sense of fated suffering, then back to the genre in criticism, and ends with the phrase of deep regret.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从舞台剧开始，转到像戏一样展开的现实灾难，再指命定的苦难，又回到文艺批评中的体裁义，最后落在表达深切遗憾的句型上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stage emptied by a story that ends in loss.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个以失去收场的故事所留下的空舞台。

branches.en: The play itself.
branches.cn: 戏剧本身。

branches.en: The real event with that shape.
branches.cn: 具有这种形态的真实事件。

branches.en: The sense that the pain was unavoidable.
branches.cn: 那种痛苦无可避免的感觉。

branches.en: The genre name in criticism.
branches.cn: 批评中的体裁名称。

branches.en: The phrase for sharp regret.
branches.cn: 表达强烈遗憾的句型。

intro.en: The word is a Greek compound whose parts are no longer felt as separate; English builds its family with -ic, -ally, and -ian.
intro.cn: 本词是希腊语复合词，各部件在英语中已不再被感知为独立成分；英语用 -ic、-ally、-ian 构成词族。
